The '''critter kitchen''' is a kobold workshop used to render [[cv:Remains|remains]] and [[cv:Bone|bones]] to [[cv:Meat|meat]]. It can also be used to make [[bonemeal]] from either. Remains produce two meat each, while bones produce one. The reverse is true for bonemeal.
